summary: Added skills/prosevoice with a thin PEP 723 launcher and the prosevoice_lib package (cwd-independent resource lookup that prefers packaged _skill/; strict layered config builtin<user<project<CLI with per-leaf provenance, XDG/home user dir, explicit/Git/cwd project selection, tier-relative anchors, per-filename guidance replacement; guide resolution; 12-kind cache/adjacent artifact paths; idempotent init and cache-ignore merge; JSON envelope with exit 0/1/2) exposing version, config, init, resolve and artifacts. Added a Hatchling pyproject (MIT, James Dixson, console entry prosevoice_lib.cli:main), seed templates, tests/test_prosevoice_config.py and tests/test_prosevoice_package.py. Both checks pass: prosevoice tests 50 OK, full suite 69 OK (the 19 original tests unmodified). Ruff is clean and the wheel builds. Legacy helpers and existing tests are byte-unchanged. Remaining commands (check, rule, policy, lint, extract, premise, ready, migrate) are deferred to later steps.
